Install: `uv tool install miseenplace-cli` (commands: `miseenplace`, `mep`).

## Fix

Right after a release, PyPI's mirrors can lag by several minutes, so an hourly auto-update in that window saw "nothing to upgrade" and treated it as a failure, blocking retries for 24 hours. mep now retries at the next hourly check, and only counts it as a failure if the new version is still missing after 6 hours.
